statistical_inference.decision_rule: The confirmatory diagnostic gate passes only when interval_excludes_zero is true for the paired Brier-reduction distribution AND every frozen point-estimate diagnostic threshold holds. A bare point estimate clearing 0.05 is not sufficient.
statistical_inference.design_description: For each confirmatory item the per-item Brier score is computed for the witnessed-structure arm and the strongest control arm using the shared adjudicated label; the paired difference (control_brier minus structural_brier) is the resampling unit. A positive difference means the structural witness reduced Brier error on that item.
statistical_inference.noise_rationale: At n=16 items the Hanley-McNeil paired-AUC standard error ranges 0.067-0.176 across plausible inter-arm correlation and label-balance assumptions, so a frozen point threshold near 0.05 sits within one third of a standard error of pure sampling noise and returns the wrong verdict roughly one time in three in both directions (23-40% error, issue #161). The interval-based rule suppresses both the false-pass and false-fail modes. Q2/Q3 are proportions over roughly eight items each: one item moves either by 0.125 and the 95% CI half-width at p=0.5 is +/-0.35 against thresholds of 0.8/0.2.
statistical_inference.seed_rationale: fixed at protocol freeze before any label or outcome; deterministic and reproducible

family_split: leave one entire mechanism family out

model.strongest_control_selection: maximum held-out ROC-AUC among non-structural controls; ties broken by PR-AUC then fixed arm order

negative_lineage.why: v1 labels were visible during construction and confirmatory use was frozen false

object: directional validity of context/QoI-scoped transfer between fresh source and target structural descriptions

positive_goal.failure_or_block: retain v1 negative history and do not submit training or inference
positive_goal.success: fresh independently annotated structural signal beyond strong controls with acceptable Q3 false accept

qoi: incremental held-out discrimination of valid transfer beyond semantic, skill and dependency-aware controls
scale_rule: Authorize LUNARC training only if the v2 annotation and diagnostic-signal gates both pass; missing evidence fails closed.
